question: If the volume of a cube is 729 cm³ then the measure of the main diagonal of the cube will be:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

**Side** of cube (a) = ³√**Volume** = ³√729 = 9 cm.

**Main Diagonal** of cube = a√3.

Diagonal = 9 × √3 = 9√3 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 9√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Volume** of the **cube** = 729 cm³

**Formula Used:**

1. **Volume** of a **cube** = a³ (where 'a' is the side length)

2. **Main Diagonal** of a **cube** = √3 × a

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/baf33804a8996237a4493405148102fc63adab32098c3e47261ed3e79b87f90c.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ a³ = 729

⇒ a = ³√729

⇒ a = 9 cm

⇒ **Main Diagonal** = a × √3

⇒ **Main Diagonal** = 9 × √3 = 9√3 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 9√3 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Total Surface Area of Cube

The sum of areas of all six faces is 6 × a².

Lateral Surface Area

Area of the four vertical faces (excluding top and bottom) is 4 × a².

Face Diagonal

The diagonal of any single square face is given by a√2.</p
